LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed. Top-left: Causal chain diagram. Top-right: Recorded series (live) line plot. Bottom-left: 32-bit float32 bit-pattern strip. Bottom-right: Monospace state card HUD.
SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss). However, no data lines or points are visible in the plot area; the series appear to be empty or flatlined at zero/NaN. A purple circular marker is visible at the top-left of the plot area (around x=0.05, y=0.95), but it has no trailing path. The trend is indeterminate due to the lack of plotted data.
TEXT: Step 59 / 59; w = 1.5160308731658936; loss = 6.247593660191342e-07; FPS readout = 8 FPS drawn | step rate 25/s; bits changed = 9 of 32; hex = 0x3FC20D46.
BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. 9 squares are orange (changed), located at positions (from left, 0-indexed): 11, 13, 16, 18, 20, 21, 23, 29, 30. The hex word is 0x3FC20D46.
DEFECTS: The "recorded series (live)" panel is effectively empty, containing no visible line data for any of the four tracked variables despite being at step 59. The purple marker is floating without a trail. The causal chain title says "(active phase: none)" while the "UPDATE" box is highlighted orange, which is a minor logical inconsistency in the text label.
VERDICT: FAIL (The primary visualization panel—the recorded series—is missing its data lines, making the "live view" non-functional for its main purpose).
